# Frozen morlet-energy-v1 fixtures

These eight JSON files contain exact input captures, full expected signatures,
localized energy tokens and 15-element feature vectors generated by the original
Go reference implementation. They cover silence/DC, tones, seeded noise, an
odd-length transient, edge impulses, a chirp and scaled/DC-shifted input.

The legacy-runtime cleanup preserves all eight JSON blobs unchanged from commit
[0594ee0](https://github.com/merkhet-io/morletdb/tree/0594ee072bfbbb52f6a432c1ebdb12bcc66275e7/testdata/morlet-energy-v1).
Their independent generator is now in
[tools/reference-go](../../tools/reference-go), moved with its extractor and tests
without source changes. Seeded inputs and numerical constants remain in that generator.
This records the cleanup's source baseline, not a claim that it originally created
the fixtures.

Rust golden tests and Go reference tests read the same frozen JSON expectations;
neither writes them. Numerical tolerance is `1e-10 + 1e-9 * abs(expected)`.
The generator must not call the Rust implementation under test.

Run `make golden` only for deliberate numerical maintenance. Review every input,
signature, token and feature change; transform changes need an extractor-version
decision and migration planning. Normal CI never regenerates these files.
